messages:
sam: hey all, sam here — first day! trying to kick off the infra pipeline from my fork and the job fails pulling the container: 403 from ghcr. Anyone seen this when onboarding?

noah: welcome :wave: most likely cause is the GitHub App not installed on your fork/repo. GHCR requires the app or a PAT with packages:read. we use the org app token, so forks can be tricky.

sam: here's the Buildkite agent output: 
```
failed to pull image "ghcr.io/redwood/ci-runner:latest": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to resolve reference "ghcr.io/redwood/ci-runner:latest": access denied: 403
{"message":"You must have read access to the container registry."}
```

maria: also check you accepted the invite to our org GitHub App (there's an email), and that you're in the okta group "redwood-ci" so Buildkite has pipeline permissions. ping me if you want me to add you.

sam: i don't see any app invite in my inbox. i did join the org.

noah: forks won't inherit the app install. either install the app on your fork (if allowed) or we can add a temporary CI token for you. maria, can you add sam to the okta group?

maria: adding him now. infra-bot will create a request for the service account token if needed.

infra-bot: Access request submitted: request_id=CI-7890, owner=maria, status=pending approval.

sam: tried restarting the build after accepting the app install on the fork, still 403. link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/infra-pipeline/builds/456

noah: ok looking at the registry logs — install was on the fork but GHCR auth token used by our pipeline is the org app token bound to the main repo. we typically solve this by running builds from the main repo or enabling "Allow forks to use org packages" (security policy). i'll open a short PR to change the pipeline to fall back to public image if GHCR pull fails for forks.

maria: temporary fix: i created a restricted PAT for sam with packages:read scope and added it to his buildkite environment var CI_GHCR_TOKEN (masked). please restart.

sam: restarted — build passed :tada: thanks all. next step for me is to run through the onboarding checklist and the first-week smoke tests.

noah: awesome. tip: add a small note in the onboarding doc about forks + GHCR so future new hires don't hit this. :memo:
